description: Create a new PDF from Markdown, plain text or a CSV table, with no template and no input PDF. This is NOT HTML-to-PDF: it does not render HTML or CSS, and it has no custom fonts or images (images in Markdown stay literal text). Text is set in the standard Helvetica family, code and monospace text in Courier, on Letter or A4 pages. Markdown supports headings 1-6, bold, italic, inline code, links (printed as text plus the URL; http(s) and mailto links are also clickable), fenced code blocks, bullet and numbered lists, one-level blockquotes, horizontal rules, pipe tables (header shaded and repeated per page; column alignment ignored) and \pagebreak; anything else prints as typed. format text keeps spaces and line breaks exactly. format csv draws a table whose first row is the header (up to 20 columns, 10,000 rows, 100,000 cells). content is capped at 512 KiB and the output at 200 pages. WinAnsi characters only (English and Western European letters and common punctuation): emoji, Cyrillic, Greek and CJK fail with unsupported_characters, naming the character and its line and column. Very large tables or heavy inline formatting fail with content_too_complex. Deterministic: the same input gives byte-identical output, and the PDF carries no PDFops footer. Returns the PDF inline as an application/pdf resource. To add text to an existing PDF use pdf_edit; to build an invoice from data use pdf_invoice.

content.description: The document: Markdown (default), plain text or CSV, up to 512 KiB of UTF-8.

font_size.description: Body text size in points, 6-36. Default 11.

format.description: How to read content. Default markdown.

monospace.description: Set the text in Courier. Only used with format text. Default false.

page_numbers.description: Print "Page n of N" at the bottom of every page. Default false.

title.description: PDF Title metadata (not printed on the page), up to 200 characters.

name: pdf_text_to_pdf

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Create a PDF from Markdown, plain text or CSV
